hero_background.description: Abstract purple neon grid for auth page background or hero section

instructions_to_main_agent.general: You are building 'GridLock', a cyberpunk authenticator. The vibe is 'High-Tech Security'. Use sharp edges, neon colors, and terminal-like fonts. Avoid rounded corners.
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_setup: Force dark mode. The app should not have a light mode. Set 'dark' class on the html element by default.
instructions_to_main_agent.font_setup: Import 'Orbitron' and 'JetBrains Mono' from Google Fonts in index.css.
instructions_to_main_agent.component_customization: Go into /components/ui and STRIP all 'rounded-md', 'rounded-lg', 'rounded-xl' classes. Replace with 'rounded-none'. Add 'border-white/10' to cards.
instructions_to_main_agent.animations: Use 'framer-motion' for the TOTP countdown timer (circular progress). Use 'sonner' for toasts.
instructions_to_main_agent.totp_logic: The TOTP codes should look like '123 456' with a monospace font. The countdown should be a progress bar or ring that changes color from Cyan -> Yellow -> Red as it expires.
instructions_to_main_agent.qr_scanner: Use 'react-qr-reader' or similar. Overlay a 'scanning grid' visual on top of the camera feed.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: Add data-testid to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards). Format: 'page-section-element-action'.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic gradients. Use solid blacks and neon borders.
Do not center align text unless it is a massive headline.
Use 2-3x more padding than usual. 'p-8' is the new 'p-4'.
Never use 'Inter' font. Use 'Orbitron' for headers, 'JetBrains Mono' for body.
All toasts must use the 'sonner' library.
Ensure all text has sufficient contrast (APCA/WCAG AA).
